crossRefs.note: Then Manoah entreated Yahweh, and said, “Oh, Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us, and teach…
But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

people.name: Mary
people.line: Mother of Jesus; wife of Joseph.

translations.web: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
translations.bsb: “How can this be,” Mary asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”
translations.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
translations.asv: And Mary said unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
